subject.title: [Bug] Upgrading from 5.28 → 6.1: cron store migrated to SQLite silently, but new jobs default to delivery.mode=announce causing channel errors

question: For isolated cron jobs with no explicit delivery, should OpenClaw preserve the existing implicit announce-to-last intent and make unresolved no-channel delivery fail soft, or change the default persisted delivery mode to none?
rationale: Both paths prevent successful agent work from being marked failed on channel-less installations, but they differ for existing users who may rely on implicit last-channel announcements.

options.title: Preserve implicit announce
options.body: Keep announce-to-last as the compatibility default and ensure an unresolved implicit target records a successful non-delivery rather than a failed cron run.

options.title: Default new jobs to none
options.body: Accept the behavior change proposed by the open PR so new isolated jobs are silent unless the user explicitly requests delivery.

options.title: Split policy by creation surface
options.body: Define and document distinct defaults only if CLI and UI user intent can be made unambiguous without adding a competing configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Preserve implicit announce
recommendation.body: Keep announce-to-last as the compatibility default and ensure an unresolved implicit target records a successful non-delivery rather than a failed cron run.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns cron job creation and delivery behavior, the area for which the issue explicitly routed this person.
